research_question: Intent update and clarification under noisy BCI interaction

inputs: all scene candidates with frozen ROI/semantic features and bbox
past public events with role, time and version
architecture.query_routing: channel queries read only deidentified diagnostic evidence; groups have separate self-attention; channel-to-intent and VLM only through a typed diagnostic summary; no reverse path
outputs: 8 soft tokens from intent and typed summary
architecture.history_attention: block diagonal by task/diagnostic group; optional shared weights, never shared cross-role attention

public_fields: raw diagnostic summary with age, count, coverage and mapping version
persistent_state.learned_cache: method/checkpoint scoped, never shared as oracle truth
persistent_state.reset_rules: freeze task, scene and mapping reset semantics in V4-02

clarification.intent_query: updates task candidates based on response evidence
clarification.known_target_probe: diagnoses channel; probe target is not user task choice
clarification.no_diagnostic_evidence: evidence insufficient unless a valid unexpired diagnostic summary exists
clarification.observational_aliasing: retain ambiguity and ask; do not force hidden-state guesses
clarification.final_policy_implementation: undecided until validation; rules must be reported as rules
clarification.channel_estimand: probability next known-target response is decoded correctly under specified mapping, covered diagnostic conditions and time window
clarification.channel_estimand_limits: not hidden-fault oracle; not automatic TASK accuracy or unseen-option calibration
clarification.mvp_policy: fixed rule shared by structural comparisons; learned query policy is an additional branch

paired_simulator.latent_trajectory: pre-generated goal/channel trajectory on common clock

training.initial_backbone: frozen with gradient through high-level VLM to prefix
training.lora_if_needed: separate equally budgeted branch for all relevant comparisons
loss_candidates: masked candidate-set/probabilistic target and outside-candidate supervision
high-level main-task CE on identifiable or set-valued targets
subtask CE if existing capability is not verified
optional interaction policy and counterfactual branches
training.subtask_requirement: verify source capability at V4-03 or add confirmed-main-task/current-observation to next-subtask labels and matched training at V4-08
training.lora_call_scope: enable on high-level call only and isolate cache; otherwise declare shared-VLM adaptation and re-evaluate low-level behavior

baselines: latest selection and fixed clarification threshold

evaluation.primary: correctly confirmed goal/task proportion under preregistered wrong-start and interaction-budget constraints
evaluation.thresholds: set from development justification and lock before test
evaluation.paired_unit: independent underlying episode/scene, not augmented rows
evaluation.formal_sample_size: not set; determine and lock before formal evaluation
evaluation.risk_constraint_unit: independent episode with >=1 wrong simulated/actual submit; all episodes in denominator
evaluation.secondary_conditional_risk: wrong submits / all submits, with count and abstention/coverage reported
evaluation.risk_test_rule: predeclare point estimate vs one-sided confidence bound; only bound-based claim can assert that form of statistical support
update_delay: total delay since private true change
response delay since first predeclared publicly identifiable change evidence, with censored episodes and coverage reported
evaluation.late_ablation_training: train/validation only; redo applicable calibration before final freeze

scope.early_visual_source: fixed annotations or privileged LIBERO, explicitly tagged
scope.future_visual_frontend: Florence/SAM after separate checks; not real EEG validation

baseline_fairness.B0_B1: engineering references with input limits disclosed
baseline_fairness.B2: same external images and public information, different representation and token cost
baseline_fairness.B3_B4_Full: same input tensors, auxiliary labels and controlled train/inference budget
baseline_fairness.all_methods: same protocol and public source fields; own predictions are not oracle public state
baseline_fairness.history_ablation: recent raw events removed; retained confirmed state/diagnostic summaries listed separately

schedule.two_to_three_weeks: controlled MVP target only, conditional on capability and resources
